concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion of MODIS, Reanalysis, and In-situ data. Tasks T011a, T011b, and T011 are marked unchecked [ ] and explicitly reference fetching data that the Analyze report flags as missing artifacts. Without these tasks being actionable and linked to the data sources in the plan, FR-001 and SC-004 (data alignment quality) are unimplementable.

FR-001 requires spatial/temporal alignment and unified masking. Tasks T012 and T013 are unchecked [ ] and the Analyze report indicates the logic for memory enforcement and basin stratification is missing or unverified. This leaves the core data processing requirement of US-1 unmet.

SC-001 (VLM vs Baseline comparison) and SC-005 (basin variance) require specific artifacts. Task T020 (generate model_comparison.csv) is unchecked [ ] and flagged as rejected in the Analyze report. Task T020a (basin variance) is also unchecked. Without these, the success criteria for US-2 cannot be measured.

SC-003 (feature attribution validity) and FR-004/FR-005 require permutation importance and spatial maps. Tasks T023, T025, and T026 are marked with [~] (incomplete/ambiguous) or [ ] and rely on upstream artifacts (T020) that are missing. The implementation path for US-3 is broken.

FR-001 and SC-004 require a validated schema for the aligned dataset. Task T009 (contract test) is unchecked [ ] and the Analyze report notes the schema file is missing, creating a circular dependency where the test cannot run without the schema, and the schema's usage is unverified.

Task ID T015 is duplicated. It appears in Phase 3 as 'Implement strict quality flag filtering' and in Phase 4 as 'Contract test for model metrics schema'. This ID collision creates ambiguity in traceability and execution.

Task ID T016 is duplicated. It appears in Phase 3 as 'Implement robust error handling' and in Phase 4 as 'Integration test for CPU feasibility'. This ID collision creates ambiguity in traceability and execution.

Task ID T021 is duplicated. It appears in Phase 4 as 'Implement explicit memory profiling' and in Phase 5 as 'Contract test for feature importance output'. This ID collision creates ambiguity in traceability and execution.
Task ID T027 is duplicated. It appears in Phase 5 as 'Implement spatial aggregation logic' and in Phase 6 as 'Update quickstart.md'. This ID collision creates ambiguity in traceability and execution.
